notes.unresolvedIntro: These saved notes are not attached to any component of this board. Nothing was deleted. Copy the text if you still need it, then delete the entry.
notes.reasonComponentMissing: No component of this board has that reference or position.
notes.reasonComponentAmbiguous: Several components of this board match, so none was chosen.
notes.reasonPinMissing: The component has no pin with that number or position.
notes.reasonPinAmbiguous: Several pins of the component match, so none was chosen.
notes.reasonLegacyIdMissing: The note was saved with an internal id that this board does not have.
notes.reasonLegacyIndistinguishable: The component or pin cannot be told apart from another one by name or position.
notes.reasonDuplicateTarget: Another note already belongs to the same component or pin.
notes.fallbackDuplicateRef: Several components share this reference, so the note is bound to this component's position on the board.
notes.fallbackUnnamedPart: The file gives this component no reference, so the note is bound to its position on the board.
notes.fallbackUnnamedPin: The file gives this pin no number, so the note is bound to its position on the board.
notes.refusePart: No note can be saved for this component: another component with the same reference lies at exactly the same position, so the two cannot be told apart.
notes.refusePin: No note can be saved for this pin: another pin without a number lies at exactly the same position, so the two cannot be told apart.
notes.reasonLegacyOrderUnknown: This older note cannot be safely matched because the reader's record order may have changed.
notes.textPlaceholder: What did you find, replace or check?
notes.measurementsLegend: Measured values (typed by you; TRACE never fills these in)
notes.blockedLocked: Saved notes could not be read, so editing is locked to protect them: {reason}
notes.saveFailed: The note was not saved. Your text is kept here; fix the problem and press Save again.
notes.draftBlocked: Save or cancel the note you are writing first. Its text is kept.
notes.draftKept: Unsaved text is kept. Save it, or delete the text to close the note.
notes.draftMoved: The note was removed elsewhere. Its text is kept here; saving adds it as a new note at the same point.
notes.draftRestored: Unsaved note text from before the switch was restored.
notes.confirmRemove: Delete this note? Its text will be removed.
